title: Colosseum 1.1.1
summary: Tankoban series pages now come from a baked catalogue with real cover art, chapters are gone in favor of volumes, and Nyaa moves behind the same opt-in gate as every other source.

highlights.title: Catalogue, offline
highlights.body: Series pages render instantly from a baked 10,000-series catalogue. No live scraping on the browse path.

highlights.title: Real cover art
highlights.body: Volume shelves carry real BookWalker cover art, with honest NO COVER tiles where art is still pending.

highlights.title: Volume-only
highlights.body: Chapter browsing and downloading are removed. Downloaded volumes stay; a one-time migration clears old chapter files.

highlights.title: Nyaa opts in
highlights.body: Nyaa is now an extension, disabled by default like every other acquisition source. Enable it in Extensions.
